title: Module h-map factors through the identity edge map
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X -> Y, modules N on Y and F on X and a coefficient morphism phi:N -> f_*F, the module cohomology h-map [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] equals the cohomology map of phi followed by moduleCohomologyEdgeMap(f,F,p), in every degree p and on every class.

source.place: Coefficient functoriality, specialized to an identity coefficient map.

proof.text: Specialize moduleCohomologyFMap_source_naturality to phi and the identity of f_*F. Evaluate its equality of additive morphisms on x. Composition with the identity equals phi, and the identity coefficient h-map is the edge map by definition.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient functoriality, specialized to an identity coefficient map.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCohomology_coefficient_factor
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {N : Y.Modules} {F : X.Modules}
    (φ : N ⟶ (pushforward f).obj F) (p : ℕ)
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj N) :
    moduleCohomologyFMap (X := X) (Y := Y) (G := N) (F := F) f φ p x =
      moduleCohomologyEdgeMap f F p
        (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).map φ).hom x)
